implement.name: Project layout
implement.summary: Server-first tree, by feature, the data boundary at the feature's api layer

implement.name: Components and props
implement.summary: Function components, ref as a prop, Server-first with 'use client' only when needed

implement.name: State and derivations
implement.summary: Derive during render, use useActionState/useTransition/useOptimistic for mutations

implement.name: Control flow
implement.summary: Suspense for readiness, form action for submission, conditional rendering during render

implement.name: Data boundary
implement.summary: Fetch in Server Components at the route segment; Client Components receive props or use(promise)

implement.name: Testing
implement.summary: Behaviour-first component tests, RSC test strategy, what tests must not reach for

implement.name: No useEffect for derived state
implement.summary: If a value can be calculated during render, an Effect is the expensive version

implement.name: No imperative DOM
implement.summary: Ref-based DOM mutation breaks the declarative contract — React owns the DOM

implement.name: No effects where event handlers belong
implement.summary: Effects run because the component was displayed, handlers run because of an interaction

implement.name: No unnecessary 'use client'
implement.summary: Adding the directive ships a transitive dependency tree to the browser for nothing

review.name: React 19 refusals
review.summary: useEffect for derived state, imperative DOM, effects-where-handlers, unnecessary 'use client'

audit.summary: Measure an existing React 19 app against these guides, finding by finding
